editorialIntent: Practical comparison of actual active Peru adventure-themed catalog, where theme is secondary in current multi-country programs: 12 vs 15-day Peru/Bolivia, Peru highlands vs Bolivia Altiplano, optional Vinicunca vs included Machu Picchu, Peruvian Amazon versus Ecuador/Galapagos. Distinct from Peru country guide and global adventure-interest hub.

constraints: Only canonical active internal links; no external URLs in rendered body. Count dynamic; never assume a theme-tagged tour includes a trek in Peru.
